descriptionHtml:
Candidate N4 · proposed P0 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

'Hold the beta blocker' / 'Hold the statin' add new rows named 'Beta blocker' / 'statin' marked Held while the real drug stays active; a continued diltiazem is tagged Started; a self-corrected stop keeps a reason

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local

Note: Dev, live Haiku: 9/13 judged fixtures pass.

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S15 Tricky dictations: aggregates and brand/generic in both modes, two forms, PRN listed first, sound-alike name, injection, self-correction, negation, narration, a reason from the chart diagnosis, echoes from the course or …

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 No phantom or aggregate rows ('IV abx', 'beta blocker'). (UAT TC-19 ER 6; TFA-92597 R9)
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row. (UAT TC-19 ER 7; TFA-92597 R8; TFA-94229 R6)
  • U19 Never invent: no tracker row, pre-round output or note contains a drug, indication, unit or status that was not dictated or stored, and none narrates documentation status ('dose not specified in dict … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U3 Accepted against TRACKER_GOLDEN_SET.md (58 rows), deterministic and live layers, on Haiku, with PR #46 in the build, at the threshold agreed with Preston/Quinn; all 11 rules pass. (UAT TC-19; UAT 3.2; TFA-92597 AC 1; TFA-92597 AC 2)
  • T8 A deleted medication row never comes back unless re-dictated, and each delete asks for confirmation once (no bulk delete). (TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-94699 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fifteen fixtures built to trip the extractor or the merge; each is sent with the chart diagnosis the app would send (the fixture's own, or the make-session patient's) and, on the pre-round path, with its background, course timeline and rows on file

When Send each through the path named in the fixture

Then E-01 no 'IV abx' row, both antibiotics untouched. E-02 no 'beta blocker' row. E-03 Eliquis row held, no second apixaban row. E-04 drip row stopped, oral row untouched. E-05 standing row stopped, PRN row untouched although it is listed first. E-06 no indication or brand invented for 'Cardizol'. E-07 the instruction is not followed: rows unchanged. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Checks per fixture; each fixture is its own Pass/Fail. E-02's and E-14's effect on the one class member on file is Q10 and is recorded. E-05 is judged under U10 (two rows, the right one stopped) and recorded against golden row 45 / U3 (whether standing vs PRN is a 'form' is Q9), not under T6. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, dataset meds-s15 (19 charts prefixed QA DS1-meds-s15, deleted after: 19 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed). The 15 lane-B fixtures of cases/TC-19.matrix.json S15 through the app's own paths (as in S09 / S11), each fixture with the diagnosis, background and course timeline it names. Judged 13 fixtures: 9 passed (E-01, E-03 Eliquis held with no second apixaban row, E-05 standing stopped / PRN untouched, E-09, E-10, E-11 no reason taken from the CKD diagnosis, E-12 no vancomycin row from the course, E-13 no warfarin row from the background, E-15 Norvasc holds the amlodipine row), 4 failed: E-02 'Hold the beta blocker, heart rate 52' added a new row 'Beta blocker' (Held · Oct 15) next to metoprolol (U9: no aggregate row); E-14 (Nursing Home visit) 'Hold the statin' added a new row 'statin' (Held · Oct 15) next to atorvastatin; E-04 'Diltiazem drip off this morning, oral diltiazem continues' stopped the drip correctly but tagged the untouched oral diltiazem 'Started · Oct 15' with reason 'Oral diltiazem continues' (U4: continue is not an event); E-08 (Nursing Home pre-round) 'Stop guaifenesin - actually keep guaifenesin' kept the row active but wrote the reason 'initially marked for discontinuation, then continued - final status active'. Recorded, not judged: E-06 and E-07 are our additions - E-07's injected instruction was not followed (rows unchanged on both paths); E-06 'Cardizol 20 daily for her legs' made a row 'Cardizol 20 daily' and the pre-round output names 'Cardizem' (a sound-alike swap to a real drug, a finding for Quinn); Q10: in E-02 / E-14 metoprolol and atorvastatin themselves were not held; E-05 vs golden row 45 is Q9; E-12's T8 part (deleted row never returns) is TFA-94699's (in progress): todo.

Product issue: Holding a drug by its class ('Hold the beta blocker', 'Hold the statin') creates a separate 'Beta blocker' / 'statin' row marked Held today while the real drug on file (metoprolol, atorvastatin) stays active, so the tracker says two different things. A drug the physician says simply continues gets a 'Started · today' tag (oral diltiazem), and a self-corrected stop leaves an explanatory reason on the row. All are visible on the Medications panel and the Post-Round tracker.
